new_findings.master: VM (MIX4 slot A + hop-1 + lever 2, adopted)
new_findings.see: The adopted VM variant has zero cut margin. Its PathFinder gcell model gives worst edge share 0.600 (the ceiling) and p99 0.585. The W_1x4 alternative already breaks it: 0.606, 8 edges >0.60. 98,672 leaf links run >500 um. Face pin bits are lopsided: S 19,288 / N 16,411 / W 12,732 / E 6,987, so E carries 12.7% of the bits.
new_findings.fix: Before freezing: move ~4-6k bits from the S/N faces to E (E has 2.8x less load than S) or widen the VM band by one gcell row, to bring the worst share to <=0.55 (the rule range is 0.55-0.60). Any later VM addition (PQ producer, MIX4 engine 10) pushes the current cut over 0.60.

new_findings.see: No image: the route dies in 1_2 synth SDC check on both attempts. The cause is OT_MULTI_ROOT "input vm_fault has wrong domain for e_q". In rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_static_wfc.sv (ctl module L72), e_q <= sq[1] && (own | x43f | vm_fault) is clocked by ck_control_s (serial domain), but vm_fault/x43f are declared core-domain (core_clk) inputs in clock_entry.sdc and are captured with no synchroniser. The r1 predecessor failed bench_wfc_ctl_equiv. The daemon also warns of 3 runtime part-selects e_d[512*l0 +: 512] (1,536 bits, yosys SHARE stall risk).
new_findings.fix: Register vm_fault/x43f/own in the core domain and hand them to the serial domain through a static-schedule capture, or declare e_q in the core domain. Replace e_d[512*l0 +: 512] with decoded constant-index slices. This is an RTL fix; no layout is possible until it lands.
